text.description_html:
LCN 1460-30, Cush Shoe Support

This is an aluminum cush shoe support for the LCN 1460 Series Door Closer. It provides an anchor for the fifth screw used with CUSH arm where reveal is less than 3-1/16".

Specifications of the Cush Arm Shoe Support Bracket:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Length: 1-15/32"
  • Width: 1-11/16"
  • Mounting Hole Center to Center: 1"

    • Sold Individually
